latest_release.name: Release 3.0
latest_release.body:
The guide now targets evergreen browsers. Every snippet that was changed is checked against jQuery 4 by a test.

## Breaking: Internet Explorer is no longer supported

Snippets target the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and Opera. IE-specific fallbacks are gone: vendor-prefixed `matchesSelector`, the `closest` polyfill, `Array.prototype.*.call`, `createEvent` / `initCustomEvent`, `pageYOffset`, `parentNode.removeChild`. If you still need IE, use the [last IE-compatible version](https://github.com/camsong/You-Dont-Need-jQuery/tree/c4e00b3) or [v2.0](https://github.com/camsong/You-Dont-Need-jQuery/tree/v2.0).

## Native one-liners

| jQuery | Native |
|---|---|
| `remove` / `insertBefore` / `insertAfter` | `el.remove()` / `el.before()` / `el.after()` |
| `empty` | `el.replaceChildren()` |
| `unwrap` / `replaceWith` | `parent.replaceWith(...parent.childNodes)` / `el.replaceWith()` |
| `$(html)` | `<template>` |
| `$.extend(true, …)` | `structuredClone()` |
| `$.Deferred` | `Promise.withResolvers()` |
| `scrollTop()` | `window.scrollY` |
| `outerHeight()` / `outerWidth()` | `el.offsetHeight` / `el.offsetWidth` |

## New sections

- Request JSON (with the `response.ok` gotcha), Post JSON, Abort and timeout
- `one` → `{ once: true }`, event delegation, removing several listeners at once with `AbortController`
- `async` / `await` variants for `always` and `then`
- Effects use the Web Animations API (`el.animate()`); `slideUp` / `slideDown` measure real height

## Fixed snippets

Snippets that threw or disagreed with jQuery: `nextAll` / `prevAll`, `:contains`, `append` / `prepend` with HTML strings, `clone` (now deep), `trigger`, `inArray`, `isPlainObject(null)`, `merge`, `globalEval`, `parseHTML`, `Deferred`, `fadeOut`, `fadeTo`, `animate`. Plus broken markdown, anchors and syntax errors in the README (#264).

## Tests and tooling

- Karma / webpack 1 / Babel 6 replaced with Vitest + jsdom; tests run in GitHub Actions on PRs and `master`
- Travis CI config and badges removed (#263)

## Translations

All 15 translations are synced with the current snippets (#268–#282).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/camsong/You-Dont-Need-jQuery/compare/v2.0...v3.0
